t: Compact and lightweight brushless twin pack featuring M18 ½” combi drill delivering 62Nm of torque, with a length of 145mm, allowing users to access tight spaces. Over 12% smaller in length than previous generation (M18CBLPP2A-402C). Also features M18 ¼” impact driver which delivers 192Nm of torque and 3600rpm in a compact, all-metal shell. Both tools feature REDLINK overload protection, and an all-metal reversible belt clip for hanging the tool quickly and easily. Supplied with 2 x M18 5.0Ah batteries, M12-18 charger and a blow-moulded kit box.
